Apply task T-AD-20: Decide the ZIP packing approach. Read the code and the SSOT, then tell me exactly what to change.

What do you mean, can you prepare and download all, without needing parent, or do we need parent due to iframe restirctions

## Direct answer Two different questions are bundled in your message, and only the second needs the parent: **1. "Download all, without a ZIP"** - already ships and needs no parent. `downloadFilesOneByOne()` (C-08), staggered by `DOWNLOAD_STEP_MS = 350` in `app/AssetDrive.js`. Each file goes through a normal browser navigation to the effective URL. No host call involved. Limitation L-01: "the browser may ask to allow multiple downloads." **2. "Pack them into one archive"** - this is where the bytes matter. A ZIP writer (JSZip, or a STORE-only writer) must read the file *content*, not the URL. Per SSOT §5.3, structural flaw 3: > **Sandbox limits.** No direct fetch, no storage APIs and no browser dialogs; every outside action must go through the tool SDK. So inside the iframe, as the tool is designed today, there is **no channel that returns file bytes**. Confirmed by the SDK surface visible in the code: `onReady`, `param`, `notify`, `resize`, `setValue`, `isReadOnly`, `getUser`, `requestUpload`, `onValueChange`, `onReadonlyChange`. None of them yields a `Blob`/`ArrayBuffer`. Therefore: - **Parent-free ZIP is not possible** unless the host relaxes two things at once: `fetch` allowed in the sandbox *and* CORS headers on the storage/CDN host allowing the CMS origin. Neither is stated in the SSOT or the code - I cannot confirm or deny them from what I was given. - **Parent relay** is the only route that fits §5.3 unchanged: add a host SDK method that returns bytes for a URL (name to be agreed with the host - I will not invent one; nothing like it exists in the code I have), then the STORE-only writer runs locally on those bytes. Caveat on evidence: the excerpt of `app/AssetDrive.js` I was given stops before `downloadFilesOneByOne()`, so I cannot confirm whether it uses an anchor click or an SDK call. Send that function if you want it verified. ## What I need to close T-AD-20 1. The `window.tool` SDK reference for the CMS sandbox - is there, or can there be, a bytes/download relay method? 2. The iframe `sandbox` attribute list used by the host (is `allow-same-origin` present?) plus whether the storage host sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. 3. The exact §15 markup for T-AD-20 (section 15 is trimmed out of my context, so I cannot quote the line to edit). ## Exact changes to `docs/ssot.html` once you choose File: `BUSINESS/GENERAL/file-media/file-management-storage/AssetDrive/docs/ssot.html` **(a) Header table - bump version** ```html Document version0.1 Last updated2026-11-17 ``` becomes the new version (e.g. `0.2`) and the change date. Also the sidebar footer, same file: ```html v0.1 ``` **(b) Section 11 - append after the `D-AD-12` row (register is append-only)** If the parent relay is chosen: ```html D-AD-132026-11-17ZIP downloads are built inside the tool as a STORE-only (uncompressed) archive from bytes returned by the host SDK relay method <host method name>. The tool never fetches an asset URL directly.Section 5.3 forbids direct fetch in the sandbox, so the bytes must come through the SDK. STORE-only avoids a compression dependency and keeps one code path.Adopted ``` If the operator instead accepts the parent-free route (only valid if fetch + CORS are confirmed): ```html D-AD-132026-11-17ZIP downloads are built inside the tool with a STORE-only writer fetching each effective URL directly. No host relay is used. Verified preconditions: iframe allows fetch and the storage host sends CORS headers for the CMS origin.Removes a host dependency, but ties ZIP to storage CORS policy - a CORS change silently breaks the feature.Adopted ``` If it cannot be decided yet, the row must be written with `class="status-proposal"` and status `Proposed` - a decision that is not in section 11 did not happen. **(c) Section 7.1 - add the answer row** ```html Can the archive be packed without the parent/host?Only if the sandbox permits direct fetch and the storage host allows the CMS origin via CORS. As specified today (5.3, no direct fetch) the bytes must come through the host SDK relay (D-AD-13). ``` **(d) Section 10, row `L-01` - status column only** ```html Deferred by D-AD-06; idea I-01 ``` becomes `Deferred by D-AD-06; approach decided in D-AD-13; implementation T-AD-21`. **(e) Section 13, row 14** ```html 14ZIP downloadsapp/AssetDrive.js - PENDING (D-AD-06, I-01) ``` becomes `PENDING (D-AD-13, T-AD-21)`. **(f) Section 15 - mark T-AD-20 done** in the same change: set `data-task-status="done"` on the T-AD-20 task `div` (and `checked` on its checkbox). I need the current markup of that block to give you the exact replaced line. T-AD-21 stays `not-started` - the decision does not implement anything. Answer to your actual question in one line: **download-all already works with no parent; ZIP cannot be built today without the parent, because the tool has no way to read file bytes - the only fitting route is a host SDK relay returning bytes, which does not exist in the code yet.**
